transport.title: FAST Michigan 261
transport.text: FAST Michigan 261 serves the airport’s Evans and McNamara terminals, Dearborn, Inkster, Corktown and downtown Detroit. FAST buses run daily, including late evenings and weekends, with roughly 15–20-minute intervals at peak times. Boarding and alighting are only at marked FAST stops; buses have Wi-Fi.

sleep.title: The Westin in McNamara
sleep.text: The Westin Detroit Metropolitan Airport is inside the McNamara terminal. The hotel has an indoor pool, fitness centre and restaurants; check-in is from 15:00 and check-out by 12:00. The minimum age to check in is 21.
